Brand Affiliate Terms & Conditions

 

Welcome to HappyTails Canine Wellness™. Thanks for considering our Brand Affiliate program! Our cherished mission is your dog’s optimal wellness. Our company is committed to providing the finest, scientifically advanced dog treats and supplement. Through our Brand Affiliate program, we strive to develop mutually beneficial partnerships with our Brand Affiliates, so we have created some terms to help guide expectations.

 

When we say “Company,” “we,” “our,” or “us” in this document, we are referring to HappyTails Canine Wellness™ a division of Au Terre™, Inc.

 

When we say “Services,” we mean any product manufactured created, distributed and /or maintained by the Company.

 

These terms may be updated at any time in the future. When updates occur, we will be sure to communicate them with you in writing via email.

 

By participating in the Brand Affiliate Program, Brand Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as a Brand Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

 

Please read this document in its entirety before accepting our invitation to become a Brand Affiliate of the Company.

Eligibility

To become a Brand Affiliate of the Company, you must:

●       Be 18 years of age or older

●       Have read, understood, and agreed to these terms.

●       Be in good standing with the Federal Trade Commission (FTC)

●       Own social media account(s)

Engagement

As a Brand Affiliate of the company, you agree to:

●       Create, post, and share content that promotes the Company’s services

●       Promote your unique promo code to increase sales for the Company

●       Maintain high ethical and moral standards within your social media accounts

Restrictions

As a Brand Affiliate you agree not to:

●       Make any guarantees, representations, or warranties on behalf of the Company, other than the ones provided in the marketing material.

●       Spam or promote the Company in a way that violates any laws or regulations.

●       Promote the company in any sexually explicit, violent, bullying, discriminatory, unlawful, threatening, illegal, or otherwise objectional content - subject to the sole direction of the Company.

●       Use the company’s brand, image, or likeness on your own website, potentially creating customer confusion

●       Run any paid advertising with your promotional codes

●       Engage in any fraudulent activity that would artificially affect any social media metrics such as, but not limited to, likes, follows, shares, and views.

●       Create multiple Brand Affiliate accounts or use more than one promo code.

●       Misrepresent or modify the price of the Company’s services

 

The Company reserves the right to request removal or modification of any Brand Affiliate content in its sole discretion.

 

Disclosure

The Brand Affiliate agrees to disclose the material connection between them and the Company.

 

The Brand Affiliate may use text such as “#sponsored” or “#ad” to disclose this relationship.

 

The disclosure should be clear and follow all guidelines by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC)

Compensation

The Brand Affiliate will be paid 10% of every sale generated through their promo code.

This percentage is subject to change by the Company at any time.

The Brand Affiliate is solely responsible for any and all tax obligations.

 

Brand Affiliate Links and Coupon

Brand Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate a Brand Affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Brand Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the Brand Affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you are not assigned a branded coupon, then you are not allowed to promote the coupon.

Brand Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.



Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost, etc.).

For a Brand Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Brand Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Brand Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review all referral orders. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

Commission is subject to change by the Company at any time. The Brand Affiliate is solely responsible for any and all tax obligations.

 

 

Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo, or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on Brand Affiliate channels.



Network

If Network tab is activated, Brand Affiliate can invite others to become their downline Brand Affiliate. If any downline Brand Affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline Brand Affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other Brand Affiliates into the system, share network link and any other Brand Affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline Brand Affiliate.



Cookies

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person does not allow cookies or clears their cookies, then we cannot track them which will interfere with our ability to pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is stated on the Brand Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the Brand Affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the Brand Affiliate (There is no need for the customer to click on the Brand Affiliate link then).

Go forward and refer!
